plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Early Childhood Education A.A. Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 09, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7283/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS. Total Units 60 = 15+16+14+15 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. This degree can be completed using either the local AA/AS GE pattern or the Cal-GETC transfer GE pattern; see a counselor. Students must complete both ECE 300 and ECE 312/PSYC 372 with a 'C' or better before taking ECE 320. ECE 320 and ECE 321 each have a lab and a lecture component; each course requires students to complete 108 hours in an approved early education classroom (practicum options: the ARC Child Development Center, the student's worksite if it meets required lab placement criteria, or a department-approved community placement site). Placements at community sites and the ARC CDC require current TB test (0-12 months), TDAP (within 10 years), and MMR immunizations; students may sign a waiver for the flu vaccine. This degree helps students complete many of the requirements for transfer to a Child Development B.A.; see a counselor for additional transfer coursework. While working toward this degree students will qualify for the Associate Teacher certificate and the Teacher certificate (Child Development permits through the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing). Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H.
